# Jishu Labs

> > Technical insights and comparisons on AI infrastructure, vector databases, and production deployment strategies from Jishu Labs.

Jishu Labs provides in-depth technical analysis and benchmarks for modern AI infrastructure, with expertise in vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus), RAG systems, and production-grade semantic search implementations. Founded by Michael Chen, the lab focuses on helping teams make informed decisions about AI tooling and architecture.

## Key Topics

- Vector Databases
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Pinecone
- Weaviate
- Qdrant
- Milvus
- Semantic Search
- AI Infrastructure
- Production Deployment
- Performance Benchmarks
- Database Selection
- OpenAI Integration
- Python
- Rust
